stop_reason: No exercise contrast: GSE250520 contains only vehicle vs IL-1beta cardiac organoids (no exercise, training, or NE/stress-test arm). The paper's 'simulated exercise' (NE stress test, S2.6.p2) is a functional beating-rate assay without RNA-seq, so the requested exercise estimand cannot be identified from these data. IL-1beta vs vehicle is not an exercise comparison and was not run as a substitute.
